chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr, from Zurarah, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم performed the Zuhr and 'Asr prayers when the sun had declined, in congregation, without any cause.
ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم combine Zuhr and 'Asr without an excuse?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم performed the Zuhr and 'Asr prayers together at the time of the sun’s decline. It indicates the permissibility of combining these two prayers even without a specific excuse.
